eng_blog.notes: The recent-posts index is construction guidance and product/marketing content, not engineering posts about how the product is built.

claygent-argon-B.reasoning: The company’s own site identifies its construction-management audience, a public pricing page, founding history, customer testimonials, and help center. LinkedIn’s stated employee count maps to 51–100. RedTeam’s current career portal says there are no jobs posted, although a specific Account Executive application page remains live; the latter supports SDR/AE hiring, while the no-openings page supports the negative AI/ML-role result. RedTeam’s dated release notes announce a report feature on November 9, 2026, within the six-month window. A July 2026 appointment of a Vice President of Finance is within the 12-month leadership window. Funding databases identify a February 2022 $28 million Series B as the latest round, outside the 18-month window. The engineering-blog, model-provider, and certification conclusions are based respectively on the marketing-oriented blog index, a RedTeam-specific partner case study, and the company’s legal/privacy page.

hq_location.notes: RedTeam’s timeline gives Orlando, Florida as headquarters; LinkedIn identifies the country as the United States.

public_docs.notes: The public Help Center has multiple product collections and hundreds of articles.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest recorded round is February 2022, before the 18-month period ending November 9, 2026.

founded_year.notes: RedTeam’s company timeline identifies 2006 as its founding year.

last_funding.notes: The funding history shows the latest deal as a $28 million Series B in February 2022.

launched_6mo.notes: On November 9, 2026, RedTeam announced expanded report options for presenting project costs, including views by division or cost code and markup-display choices.

pricing_page.notes: The public page describes APV-based pricing and a calculator/custom quotes.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn lists 98 employees; another directory gives a slightly higher band, so this uses the company profile’s stated count.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A direct RedTeam application page is open for an Account Executive—SMB role; the general job board separately says there are no jobs posted.

model_provider.notes: A RedTeam-specific AI document-extraction case study identifies Bedrock as the AI interpretation service; this supports the extraction pipeline, not necessarily every AI feature.

named_customers.notes: Both are identified in customer testimonials on RedTeam’s homepage.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The company’s job board states that there are no jobs posted at this time.

compliance_certs.notes: The legal/privacy page describes general security safeguards but names none of SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, or PCI DSS.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The Revenue Operations Manager posting names both systems.

product_one_liner.value: RedTeam provides construction-management software for small and mid-sized commercial general contractors to manage projects, financials, documents, and team coordination in one connected platform.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: RedTeam announced Connor Schone’s appointment as Vice President of Finance on July 9, 2026.
